question: The All India Trade Union Congress worked for the improvement of the workers’ working and living conditions. One of the main leaders of this was ________.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**MN Roy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **MN Roy**, also known as **Manabendra Nath Roy**, was one of the prominent leaders of the **Indian Communist Movement** and an influential figure in founding **All India Trade Union Congress (AITUC).**
 
• He played a significant role in advocating for the **rights and better working conditions** of workers in India.
